pages.text: $(bold)Steve's Advanced Storage$() extends $(bold)Steve's Simple Storage$() with bigger, smarter storage and automation. Everything in your simple-storage network still works — you simply add $(bold)Advanced Storage Cores$() for more capacity and power.
This guide is organized into $(bold)Storage Blocks$(), $(bold)Generators$() and $(bold)Automation$(). If you are new, start with the $(l:storage_blocks)Storage Blocks$() category.
